description: This API calculates a driving route for cars with turn-by-turn directions by submitting at least a start and endpoint.
name: Get Route

alternatives.description: Show alternative routes? Either `true`, `false` (default) or a number [1,..,n] (of alternative routes to show if available).

annotations.description: Defines if additional data for each coordinate should be returned. Either `true`, `false` (default), `nodes`, `distance`, `duration`, `datasources`, `weight`, or `speed`.

approaches.description: Keep waypoints on curb side for each waypoint defined in coordinates path parameter.

bearings.description: Limits the search to segments with given bearing in degrees towards true north in clockwise direction for each waypoint defined in coordinates.

continue_straight.description: Forces the route to keep going straight at waypoints constraining U-turns there even if it would be faster. Default is `default`, which translates to `true`.

coordinates.description: At least two coordinates as start and endpoint of route, defined by longitude and latitude. Required format: `{longitude},{latitude};{longitude},{latitude}`. Alternatively, a polyline or polyline6 as input is allowed.

exclude.description: Type of step to be avoided on route. Can be either `motorway`, `ferry`, or `toll`.

geometries.description: Returned route geometry format (influences overview and per step). Either `polyline` (default), `polyline6`, or `geojson`.

overview.description: Add overview geometry either `full` or `simplified` according to the highest zoom level it could be displayed on a map, or not at all (`false`). Default is `simplified`.

radiuses.description: Limits the search to given radius in meters. Set one radius for each waypoint defined in coordinates path parameter.

skip_waypoints.description: Removes waypoints from the response. Default is `false`.

snapping.description: Default snapping avoids is_startpoint edges, `any` will snap to any edge in the graph.

steps.description: Get turn-by-turn direction information. Default is `false`.

waypoints.description: Treats input coordinates indicated by given indices as waypoints in the returned match object. Default is to treat all input coordinates as waypoints.
